normalized.description: The wide adoption of AI in Earth Observation (EO) has been hindered in some cases by the lack of the transparency and explainability of the underlying decision makings process of AI algorithms and the limited explainability and trustworthiness of the proposed model outcomes and predictions. The objective of this activity is to provide a significant methodological improvement in the field of AI explainability for EO, as well as its application to downstream applications in the field of Rapid mapping of disasters and Climate Change. Another key output of the activity shall be the development of a state-of-the-art open-source AI model aimed to help end users/stakeholders with fast, accurate and trustworthy AI model outputs. The model itself and its outputs shall be inherently interpretable and self-explainable, e.g. at the same time as predicting, the model will generate text output to help understand the rational and/or reasoning. This activity shall be applied to at least two downstream use cases (Rapid mapping of disasters and Climate Change) provided by end-users engaged in the activity. These use-cases shall have high impact in the field and end-users' activity.
